name: nidavellir-ide
description: Nidavellir — an AI-assisted desktop coding environment
author: ninja94650

scripts.test: node --test tests/security.test.js tests/smoke.test.js tests/updater.test.js tests/user-plugins.test.js tests/project-tools.test.js tests/environment-doctor.test.js tests/git-service.test.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run copy:monaco && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run copy:monaco && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run copy:monaco && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.release: npm test && npm version patch -m "Release v%s" && git push --follow-tags
